verdict.rationale: An on-device ML inference runtime is a fair question for a game engine, but nothing in the evidence pack documents an official Godot inference runtime or model-execution API. GDExtension and the C#/.NET runtime are only developer building blocks a developer could use to integrate a third-party runtime, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a game developer, I can run ML models inside the game — an official inference runtime for on-device model execution
